deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next implement housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference for this doc-slim wave.
description: Pre-wave line counts of implement doc surfaces, captured before the housekeep measured doc-reduction wave. The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT LARGER than these baselines, records the measured reduced|no-op verdict, and asserts the load-bearing tokens survived. Reduction is REPORTED, never MANDATED: an already-clean no-op is a valid PASS (coding-rules §6 / measure-reduction.py contract).
